summary: Kashif Wasim, a nonpartisan candidate for Trustee Area 4 on the New Haven Unified School District board, holds a general-election endorsement from CAIR Action and an Ally rating from Vote for Peace. Both organizations assess candidates on Gaza and foreign-policy positions, and directional recommendations at this tier are treated as concrete stance evidence. The candidate's campaign platform addresses only local education, campus safety, and board accountability.
